verses.1: The wise woman built her house with seven pillars.
verses.2: Tavkah tavkah maska yena af arkha shulchanah.
verses.3: She sent her daughters to call upon the gods of Keret.
verses.4: Who could be so heartless as to say such a thing?
verses.5: Go and fight in my battles, and drink from my cups.
verses.6: They left suddenly, and they lived and worked along the path.
verses.7: He removes the curse from him, and he punishes the wicked.
verses.8: Do not be angry, for then they will resent you. Be patient and wise, and they will love you.
verses.9: Give to the wise, and they will continue to know. Give to the righteous, and they will be blessed.
verses.10: The beginning of wisdom is fearing the Lord and having knowledge of the sacred things.
verses.11: For your days will grow long, and they will add more years to your life.
verses.12: If you’ve been wise, then you’re wise for yourself alone. It’s better to be alone than to be surrounded by foolish people.
verses.13: The fire of ignorance is like a pit of darkness; it’s full of ignorance and lack of knowledge.
verses.14: And she sat at the door of her house, on a stone throne made of carnelian.
verses.15: To invite those who are travelers along the road to their homes.
verses.16: Who could be so cruel and heartless? She said to him:
verses.17: The waters of plundering will be dried up, and the secrets of darkness will be revealed.
verses.18: And they did not know that there were healers there, in the depths of Shaul Krayeh.
